children: U.S. sleep and respiratory device maker's Q1 revenue rose 6%, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q1 rose 14%, beating analyst expectations
Company returned over $1 bln to shareholders via buybacks and dividends in Q1
Resmed expects FY 2027 revenue of $5.75 bln to $5.85 bln
Company maintains FY 2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance of $12.00 to $12.25
Resmed reiterates FY 2027 core constant currency revenue growth guidance of 5% to 7%
SLEEP DEVICES AND MASKS DEMAND - Co said strong global demand for sleep devices and masks drove Q1 revenue growth
PRODUCTIVITY GAINS - Co attributed gross margin improvement to productivity pipeline execution
DIVESTITURE IMPACT - Proceeds from MatrixCare sale and strong cash flow enabled investment in innovation and shareholder returns
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 11 "strong buy" or "buy", 10 "hold" and 2 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advanced medical equipment & technology peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for ResMed Inc. is $240.00, about 4.1% below its October 28 closing price of $250.17
The stock recently traded at 20 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
